tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search Remocn Remotion components by what they do or by the need they serve; matches by meaning as well as by words. Returns name, docs .md URL, a preview page link to show the user, vibe, length (frames @30fps; double it in a 60 fps composition), use/avoid notes and install command.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Full markdown docs for one Remocn component: props, usage example, use/avoid notes and install command.

tools.name: plan_video
tools.description: Turn a video brief into a storyboard: picks an archetype, returns its recipe and a beat list with suggested Remocn components per beat.

tools.name: preview_component
tools.description: Live in-chat preview of a Remocn component with optional props. Also returns its docs URL and install command.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_components" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search Remocn Remotion components by what they do or by the need they serve; matches by meaning as well as by words. Returns name, docs .md URL, vibe, length (frames @30fps; double it in a 60 fps composition), use/avoid notes and install command." → after: "Search Remocn Remotion components by what they do or by the need they serve; matches by meaning as well as by words. Returns name, docs .md URL, a preview page link to show the user, vibe, length (frames @30fps; double it in a 60 fps composition), use/avoid notes and install command."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
